summary_points: Document No: 4521-ESP-ANC-68-71-I250
Job No: 120006
Alternate billing cycle allowed
Mineral wool is the base material for insulation
Contractor must review all P&IDs and drawings before bidding
Contract allows alternate billing cycles.
Confidential information must not be disclosed without permission.
Contractor must coordinate with Abener Teyma Activity Manager.
Insulation must meet specifications and include all components.
Vendor responsible for complete installation despite minor variations.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Materials must be stored protected from weather.
Insulation installation depends on previous work completion.
Material substitutions require approval by Abener Teyma Activity Manager.
Insulation surfaces must be clean and dry.
Workmanship must meet industry standards.
Insulation should be protected from mechanical damage.
Damaged insulation must be repaired properly.
Equipment nameplates and code plates should not be covered.
Use pre-formed or shaped insulation segments when available.
Insulation must accommodate thermal expansion and be neatly applied.
Valves and flanges require specific insulation methods.
Personnel protection insulation is mandatory at certain heights.
Tanks, vessels, and equipment must be 100% insulated.
Breathing mastic protective covering may be used in specific cases.
Insulation must be applied over stiffeners and surfaces with specific fasteners.
ASME coded items require recertification for field welding.
Cylindrical surfaces need strapping bands, vertical vessels may require support rings.
Vessel heads should have radial bands and a floating ring.
Girth bands are placed around the periphery of vessels.
Code nameplates must not be insulated.
Arc-welding is restricted to certain materials.
Aluminum jacketing requires specific protection and reinforcement.
The contract allows for alternate billing cycles.
Insulation must be weatherproof and watertight.
Stainless steel screws with neoprene washers are required for longitudinal joints.
Silicone sealant is used to prevent moisture penetration.
Insulating cement should only be used on small complex surfaces.
Confidential and proprietary information.
Specification form revision 3/2011.
